{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast
data['revenue_numeric'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
internal_test_mask = (data['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99)

# Filter for completed orders and exclude internal test orders
completed_orders = data[(data['status'] == 'completed') & (~internal_test_mask)]

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = completed_orders['revenue_numeric'].sum()

# Output values for report
print(f"Total revenue from completed orders (excluding internal test orders): {total_revenue:,.2f}")
print(f"Number of completed orders (excluding test): {len(completed_orders)}")"}
